long_biography.plain_text:
Giovanni Mahler studied business administration at Columbia University before starting work in the oil and gas department of New York investment bank Loeb, Rhoades & Co. An early assignment involved financing refinery construction in Iran, linking his financial training with the international petroleum business.

Later, through a company owned with Joerg Bucherer, he invested in a mineral-sands project in Mozambique's Zambezi valley. The venture acquired a local business to develop a pilot plant. In 2022 it agreed to bring in Netoil Capital as a half-owner, with completion dependent on a production permit.
long_biography.html:
Giovanni Mahler studied business administration at Columbia University before starting work in the oil and gas department of New York investment bank Loeb, Rhoades & Co. An early assignment involved financing refinery construction in Iran, linking his financial training with the international petroleum business.

Later, through a company owned with Joerg Bucherer, he invested in a mineral-sands project in Mozambique's Zambezi valley. The venture acquired a local business to develop a pilot plant. In 2022 it agreed to bring in Netoil Capital as a half-owner, with completion dependent on a production permit.
